description: Read-only immutable release tuple observer; emits no environment or manifest values.

runCommand:
import base64, hashlib, json, os, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
expected = json.loads(base64.b64decode(os.environ['SSM_ExpectedTupleBase64']))
data = Path('/run/chalk/release/release-manifest.json').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == expected['manifest_sha256'], 'manifest differs'
manifest = json.loads(data)
uid = subprocess.check_output(['id', '-u', 'chalk'], text=True).strip()
def inspect(name):
    return json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['runuser', '-u', 'chalk', '--', 'env', 'XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/' + uid, 'podman', 'inspect', name], text=True))[0]
for role in ('api', 'sync'):
    assert inspect('chalk-' + role)['ImageName'] == manifest['images'][role], 'component image differs'
for role in ('capture', 'render'):
    observed = inspect('chalk-recorder-' + role)
    assert observed['ImageName'] == manifest['images']['recorder_control'], 'recorder controller image differs'
    values = dict(item.split('=', 1) for item in observed['Config']['Env'])
    member = expected[role]
    assert values['CHALK_RECORDER_FLEET_IMAGE_ID'] == member['image_id'], 'loaded worker image differs'
    assert values['CHALK_RECORDER_FLEET_RELEASE_ID'] == member['release_id'], 'loaded worker release differs'
    assert values['CHALK_RECORDER_FLEET_IMAGE_DIGEST'].removeprefix('sha256:') == member['content_sha256'], 'loaded worker digest differs'
print('CHALK_RELEASE_MATCH')
